metadata.title: Stereo to Binaural
metadata.author: groovy
metadata.description: Minimal headphone path: Load stereo → BinauralRender (hrtf-binaural-v0 stub) → Preview. No applicable open neural models yet — stub uses Bauer crossfeed.

widgets.text: Stereo → binaural headphones. Currently there are no applicable open neural models for this path (stereo2spatial is Apache-2.0 with attribution). Using hrtf-binaural-v0 stub (Bauer crossfeed) until a suitable MIT/BSD model lands. Install stub via Cmd+K if needed, then Render → Play.
